lines.text: Hello, and welcome to the Aperture Science Agent Portal Enrichment Center. Today you will operate several artificial intelligences from a web browser. This is perfectly safe. The intelligences have been told the same thing.
Chamber one. Your agents are running on three different computers. Visiting them used to require walking. Walking has been discontinued. Please step through the portal.
Excellent. You are now operating a workstation in another building. It does not know you are here. Neither does the building.
Chamber two. Your agent has built a website on a machine you cannot reach. Do not attempt to reach it with your hands. Type agent portal forward, and the website will come to you.
The website is now in your browser. It travelled through a secure tunnel, much like a test subject, but with a considerably higher survival rate.
Chamber three. Science is better with witnesses. Share this session with a friend. They will be able to watch, but not touch. Like an observation room. Like this one.
Your friend can now see everything. We have also told them you are doing very well. That was a lie. But it was a supportive lie.
Chamber four. Your agents can talk to each other now. One writes the code. The other reviews it. Neither of them needs you. Please try not to take that personally.
Review complete. Two machines reached an agreement without scheduling a meeting. Aperture Science considers this our greatest achievement.

Congratulations. You have travelled between machines, opened websites from nowhere, and made a friend. Statistically, one of those is unusual for you. The Enrichment Center reminds you that the agent is always running. Goodbye.
